title: Tetrachromatic colour vision in the duck (Anas platyrhynchos L.): microspectrophotometry of visual pigments and oil droplets
why: The abstract (opened on the publisher page) gives four single-cone pigment peaks near 420, 452, 502 and 570 nm, oil droplet cut-offs and an estimated spectral sensitivity of the cone types; the full text would give the spectral range for the commonest duck genus and the figures behind it.
